xkcd_latest.title: Tiny Squirrels
xkcd_latest.alt: It's actually an open question why squirrels are so rare. Some theories of the vacuum suggest there should be enormous numbers of them at every point in empty space; it's hard to get the equations to cancel out and produce the observed small number.

xkcd_random.alt: I'll never forget you--at least, the parts of you that were important red flags.
